operations.detail: Remote HEAD, same-owner lease, revision13 queue and absent release, Code-Point, consensus, migration and acceptance outputs were revalidated.
Official OS Data Hub Code-Point Open release metadata, all-GB coverage, CSV/GeoPackage supply and OGL attribution were registered.
Ten CSV fields, EPSG:27700 coordinates, one-metre resolution and PQI values 10,20,30,40,50,60,90 were registered.
The exact stratified manifest will be checked against the unique GB CSV archive with official size and MD5 verification.
Postcode normalization, unique download selection, MD5, ZIP parsing, PQI, coordinate bounds, sample identity and no-promotion rules are covered.
At least 365 exact Code-Point postcode records are required before the crosscheck passes.
At least 346 non-PQI-90 coordinate records are required; postcode points remain non-parcel evidence.
Ofcom, ONSPD and Code-Point Open exact-postcode evidence are combined on the same 384 row identities; HMLR provides indicative spatial support.
Exact row identity, three-source core quorum, HMLR spatial support, 40-row preview and fail-closed safety rules are covered.
Ofcom, ONSPD and Code-Point must all support at least 365 identical manifest rows.
At least 346 core-quorum rows must also have Code-Point coordinates and an HMLR indicative polygon.
Sixteen Code-Point, sixteen source-consensus and ten pipeline-manifest tests passed in local code preflight only.
The same attempt now targets 55 serial steps, 346 tests and 46 source checks; no replay, new runner or global-current-task takeover occurred.
No Code-Point archive crosscheck, four-source consensus, UPRN join, candidate validation or business-row write is claimed before canonical-runner recovery.
